title: OneDrive for Business Deployment & Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 SharePoint administration).

SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Deploy OneDrive for Business with sync, KFM, and governance done right
problem: OneDrive is where users' files live — deployed carelessly it means data loss, uncontrolled sync, and sharing risk. This solution deploys and governs OneDrive for Business: client deployment and silent config, Known Folder Move (KFM), sync controls (allow/block, restricted domains), storage and retention, sharing alignment, and offboarding/data-retention on departure — so user data is protected, synced, and governed.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the OneDrive model: client deployment + silent sign-in, KFM, sync controls, storage/retention, sharing, and offboarding.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO/OneDrive admin, client-deployment channel (Intune/GPO), storage/retention policy, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — deploy + silently configure the client, enable KFM, set sync controls (allow/block, restricted domains), set storage + retention, align sharing, and define offboarding/data-retention — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (client deployed, KFM redirecting, sync controlled, offboarding works) plus Best Practices for OneDrive governance.
short: Deploy and govern OneDrive for Business — client deployment + silent config, Known Folder Move, sync controls, storage/retention, sharing alignment, and offboarding — so user data is protected and governed. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.

bottom_line: User files protected, synced, and governed — OneDrive deployed silently, Known Folders redirected, sync controlled, offboarding handled — no more data loss on a lost laptop.
